messages.en: I don't feel like going out tonight unless you come with me.
Sure. I'll pick you up at your place at eight, okay?

senses.en_definition: To do or carry out a task, action, or activity.

collocations.en: make a mistake; commit an offence

senses.en_definition: To promote the sale of goods; to make goods sell.
To behave or conduct oneself in a particular way.

messages.en: I think I've made the same mistake again. I accidentally sent the old file to the lecturer. How do I fix this?
Send the right file now, then message the lecturer. Just say you sent the wrong one earlier.

senses.en_definition: To do it; to carry out the action previously mentioned.

messages.en: My fan's broken. Reckon I could fix it myself by following this video?
I tried fixing it by following that video, but it didn't work. Putting it back together was pretty tricky too.
In that case, I'll just take it to a repair shop.

senses.en_definition: To pass through or along a place or route; to go through an experience.
Through or by means of a medium, channel, or intermediary.
(Archaic) To disobey or act contrary to teachings, rulings, or commands.
To pass by or go beyond something; to skip or pass over it.
With the passage of time; as time goes by.

messages.en: I'm at the hall, but the front door's closed. How do I get in?
Just come in through the back door. I'll wait for you there.
Okay, I see it now. I'm coming over.
